falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes more than 4% above or below its level at the start of the 14-day window on any session
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A move of that size resolves the phase, so UNKNOWN plus HOLD is wrong — the tape has already chosen a direction.

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern similarity to bottom_2024_aug falls below 50% on the tracked match score
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The only partial analog supporting patience has broken, so a hold justified by that 77% match is invalidated.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70, or at or below 15, on any daily reading in the window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A score of 38 is a mid-range non-event; an extreme reading means the regime is a blowoff or a washed-out reset, not an unresolved hold.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
